generation.scope: A four-tensor whose four diagonal edge restrictions belong to the same complete-intersection net of quadrics splits into a bisymmetric tensor and a four-form. In the high-order finite rank-eight residual branch the common octad aligns the positions, and the common irreducible quadric forces the symmetric opposite block to have rank at least three. The four-form must vanish, contradicting the required nonsymmetric marked slice. Thus every still undecided planar mark has an equation of order two or three.

open_mathematics: Treat planar marks with quadratic or cubic initial relations. In the cubic case compare the leading vector equation with the tangent-cone cubic pencil. In the other ranks resolve branching with a nonlinear corridor.
